product.name: JTM DZR Straight Female Iron
product.description:
This sturdy JTM compression female iron features female threading for making easy connections between pipes. The compression fitting forms a solid joint when you tighten the nut, in turn compressing the ring onto the connected pipe or tube.
As a DZR fitting (Dezincification Resistant Brass), this compression female iron is perfect for applications that deliver and contain drinking water, including commercial and residential construction applications. DZR is highly resistant to corrosion with its lower zinc content, making it not only safe but also incredibly dependable and durable to withstand longevity use. DZR is also resistant to dezincification – which is the process of zinc corroding out of the brass. With this process removed, your compression female iron is far less likely to leak and once again ensures your fitting stays perfectly intact. Features & Benefits: JTM DZR Straight Female IronLong-lasting and cost-efficient  Easy-to-use threading system and simple installation process   A range of sizes available.

product.name: Self-Colour Black Malleable Mild Steel Pre-Cut Tube 1 inch (33.4mm OD)
product.description: This mild steel self-colour pre-cut tube with screwed both ends from JTM is ideal for DIY projects on both smaller and more advanced levels. It’s certified to BS1387 standard, making it suitable for use on hot and cold waterlines, firefighting lines, certain fuel lines and more. Because it’s self-colour, this durable tube is ideal for DIYers who would like to have the option to either weld the product or paint it in a particular colour to better fit their project requirements.  The wall thickness of these 1" malleable mild steel pipes is 3.2mm, and they have a 34mm outside diameter. They’re available in a wide range of lengths from 62mm to 3000mm and are extremely quick and easy to install, making them an extremely versatile and highly convenient solution. What’s more, JTM is happy to get longer lengths of tubing cut to any size upon request. Features & Benefits: Self-Colour Black Malleable Mild Steel Pre-Cut Tube 1 inch (33.4mm OD)High quality product  Designed to BS1387 standard  Can be welded or painted  3.2mm wall thickness for 1 inch  Available in 62mm-3000mm lengths or bespoke cuts  Quick and easy to installPlease note: All threads may not be identical. When requesting tubing cuts to a specific length, the result may be in or out by a couple of millimetres. Requested cut lengths of tubing cannot be returned for a refund unless previously approved due to this being a bespoke item made to the customer’s request. The actual outside diameter of the tube does measure differently to the size quoted due to the steel piping being a measure of the internal rather than the external diameter.

product.name: JTM Large Stainless Steel Parallel Spring Check Valve
product.description: This high-quality spring-loaded check valve by JTM utilises a spring to help close the check valve prior to fluid flow reversal. It helps prevent backflow and eliminates the hydraulic shock. Made from stainless steel, it features a metal seat. It has BSP parallel female ends and is available in a huge range of sizes from 1/4" to 4", making it an endlessly versatile solution. Sizes 1/4"-1" are 82 bar rated, 1 1/4"-1 1/2" 69 bar rated and 2"-4" 62 bar rated. The spring check valve is suitable for use in a wide number of plumbing applications and can operate in temperatures between -25°C and +180°C. Last but not least, it’s approved by ATEX (the European certification granted to equipment tested to be intrinsically safe), so you know it’s built to the highest industry standards and safe to use. product.name: Microbubble Stainless Steel Air Separator
product.description: This Air Separator has been designed to eliminate problems arising through the air in a water system. Suitable for heating and chilled water systems, this Air Separator includes DN50 flanged connections. With reduced commissioning time after the initial fill, this air separator results in longer system life. Made from stainless steel construction with high corrosion resistance, this Air Separator is lightweight, reducing the need for extra support. With a large collector for large intervals between flushes, this Air Separator can be flushed while in operation. This Air Separator uses deaeration for the removal of dissolved gases from liquids such as air from water.

product.name: Air & Dirt Separators
product.description: This combined air (deaerator) and dirt separator is demountable and features a high capacity auto air vent, fast bleed valve and drain valve. With greatly reduced commissioning times after the initial fill, this combined separator provides a longer system life due to the air and dirt elimination. As air collects in the air chamber before being automatically vented, floating dirt can be removed by opening the valve situated under the air vent. This same valve is used for releasing air when filling the system. The large collector ensures that flushing is only require now and then and can be flushed while fully operational without the need to shut down. product.name: JTM Stainless Steel Air & Dirt Separator Chemical Dosing Pots
product.description: Dosing pots are required to feed liquid chemicals, such as corrosion inhibitors, into closed systems. These dosing pods by JTM allow for closed re-circulating hot or called water systems to be dosed on a regular or manual basis. Supplied complete with all valves, they consist of a stainless steel vessel with inlet (return) and outlet (flow) valves, a drain valve and a filling valve, steel tundish, air release valve, wall mounting brackets and a non-return valve (NRV). Fitted across flow and return lines, the dosing pods provide a means to annex a portion of the system water which can be drained away and replaced with the chemical to be dosed. When reconnected to the system, the chemical is flushed through. The dosing pots are fitted with large 1 inch valves, which ensure quick and easy action of the pot even in low flow/pressure conditions. An air vent valve enables the pot to be purged during filling, thus eliminating undesirable airflow to the system. An NRV check valve is fitted into the fill line below the tundish.Features & Benefits: JTM Stainless Steel Air & Dirt Separator Chemical Dosing PotsHigh quality chemical dosing pots  Made of stainless steel shell & tundish  Welded to BS EN 287  Supplied with all necessary valves
product.variant_name: DISCON-Stainless Steel Chemical Dosing Pots - 16l

product.name: Templers Telux Flux
product.description: This Templers Telux flux is a general-purpose soldering flux used for capillary joints on copper pipework, brass and mild steel and other metals. It is supplied in 50gram and 450gram containers. Telux is UK WRAS listed for use with both hot and cold water including potable water. It is also suitable for use with gas pipework.For normal usage, remove any scale and oxide with emery cloth or wire wool. Wipe joint areas clean. Smear a thin film of this Telux to both surfaces and assemble. Apply heat with a soldering iron or blowtorch adding solder as required. Allow to cool and set, then wipe clean whilst still warm.Features & Benefits: Templers Telux FluxUsed for capillary joints on a variety of metalsSupplied in a range of sized containersFor use with both hot and cold water and gas pipeworkStandards & CertificationUK WRAS listedPlease note: Handling instructions: In normal use, it is advised that a suitable barrier cream be used to protect sensitive skin. Avoid inhaling fumes where possible but our tests have shown the fumes to be relatively harmless. Do not ingest this flux and avoid skin and eye contact.
